answer.headline: In the on-time months of CY2025, SNA had the higher departure delay rate and LAX had the longer average taxi-out
answer.body:
A full CY2025 comparison is not available. On-time departures do not cover January through August 2025, and the calendar-year window was out of coverage. The figures below are calculated for {F1.period} only, the part of CY2025 inside on-time coverage.

Departure delay rate ({F1.definition}) was {F1} at Los Angeles International (LAX) and {F2} at John Wayne Orange County (SNA). Both are {F1.class}. LAX minus SNA is {F5}. As a percent difference relative to SNA, the LAX rate is {F7}.

Average taxi-out was {F3} at LAX and {F4} at SNA, also {F3.class}. LAX minus SNA is {F6}. As a percent difference relative to SNA, the LAX average is {F8}.

On-time coverage of airline departures in the same window was {F9} at LAX and {F10} at SNA. These delay and taxi-out results describe domestic flights of reporting carriers, not every departure at either airport.

claims.text: For {F1.period}, the LAX departure delay rate was {F1} ({F1.class}) and the SNA rate was {F2} ({F2.class}).
The LAX-minus-SNA difference in departure delay rate is {F5} ({F5.class}). The percent difference of the LAX rate relative to SNA is {F7}.
For {F3.period}, average taxi-out was {F3} at LAX and {F4} at SNA, both {F3.class}.
The LAX-minus-SNA difference in average taxi-out is {F6}. The percent difference of the LAX average relative to SNA is {F8}.
On-time coverage of airline departures was {F9} at LAX and {F10} at SNA over {F9.period}.

Within this partial window, covered SNA departures were delayed at a higher rate than covered LAX departures, while covered LAX departures had the longer average taxi-out. In relative terms versus SNA, the taxi-out gap ({F8}) is larger in magnitude than the delay-rate gap ({F7}).

assumptions: Los Angeles International (LAX) is Los Angeles International Airport in Los Angeles, CA.

Santa Ana John Wayne (SNA) is bound to John Wayne Orange County International Airport in Santa Ana, CA. The combined name did not resolve; the code SNA and the city Santa Ana each resolved to that single airport. This contrast is answered under that binding.
The requested period is CY2025. Because that window is not fully covered by on-time departures, the comparison uses {F1.period} only.
limitations: Full CY2025 departure delay rate and average taxi-out cannot be established. On-time departures in this catalog run from September 2025 through August 2026. January through August 2025 are outside coverage. Months in 2026 fall outside the requested year and were not included.

On-time metrics cover domestic flights of reporting carriers only. International flights and smaller carriers are excluded. Coverage of airline departures differs between the airports ({F9} at LAX, {F10} at SNA), so the comparison is not airport-wide and the measured shares are not equal.
The rate difference {F5} uses the same display as the rates. The percent differences {F7} and {F8} are LAX relative to SNA.
Unmet demand, terminal capacity, fares, and profitability are not measured. No cause of either gap is established by these data.
